(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/check-oauth-requirement.md): Lightweight, no MCP connection: reports whe
ther the server is configured to require an OAuth grant.\n- [List tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-too
ls.md): Returns the server's tools as a collection page. Each item is the MCP tool definition (`name`, `description`, `inputSchema
`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-prompts.md): Returns the server's prompts as a co
llection page.\n- [List resources](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-resources.md): Returns the server's resou
rces as a collection page.\n- [Read a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-resource.md): Reads a sing
le resource by URI and returns its contents.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-server-
skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skills it adver
tises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, because duplicate detection spans the whole
listing.\n- [Get a server skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/get-a-server-skill.md): Fetches one skill by UR
I and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the manifest, the fetched frontmatter against what the list
ing advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial listing never mentioned. When a check fails the response ca
rries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a server skill's supporting file](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-server-skill
s-supporting-file.md): Reads one supporting file belonging to a skill, checking its byte length and digest against the skill's own
manifest. The manifest is the read allowlist and is re-fetched here rather than accepted from the caller, so a request cannot aut
horize its own read.\n- [Export a server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/export/export-a-server-snapshot.md): List
s tools, resources, and prompts in one call and returns a single JSON snapshot — handy for diffing a server's surface over time in
CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call-a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns t
he MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of `executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in
the result) are **successful calls** — the server answered; only transport/auth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Renders a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPro
mptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App widget headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
xecution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and mount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium runn
ing the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, what it logged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget
as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
xecution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments
return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after
its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local Chromium context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created
the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, proj
ect and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an accessibility tree and addressable elements without replay…\n- [Act
on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local In
spector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the or
iginal subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one coordinate action with fresh project/server author
ization.\n- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available
only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A sessi
on is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion,
using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/close-a-reta
ined-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a
verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disp
oses the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: wh
o made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties
one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to
a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): A
PPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: your
own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts. Another member's personal account never app
ears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-a
ccounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missi
ng one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountId
s`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account
.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an
unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The tok
en's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same
token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a
-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name anoth
er account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{a
ccount}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is remov
ed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pul
l requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval s
uite on a repository's pull requests](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests
